jobs.description:
Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:

• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!

• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.
• You have basic PC skills.
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.
• You speak good Dutch or English.

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

Your responsibilities:

• Coordinate the administration related to invoices and commitments, including leasing, housekeeping, payroll, real estate taxes and travel expenses.
• Monitor relevant expenditures against budget and follow up with external parties such as suppliers, municipalities and surveyors when required.
• Coordinate the external audit process and prepare or review audit documentation and samples.
• Review account reconciliations, including accruals, prepayments and suspense accounts, as well as payroll reconciliations in cooperation with the Payroll Manager.
• Contribute to month-end closing and management reporting by analysing account movements and explaining significant fluctuations.
• Ensure accurate intercompany accounting and recharges.
• Coordinate VAT, real estate tax and other relevant tax compliance activities together with the Tax department.
• Support budgeting activities and the preparation and review of statutory accounts.
• Contribute to financial reporting for subsidiaries in line with IFRS and local GAAP.
• Support accounting activities related to mergers, acquisitions and entity integrations.
• Coordinate local GAAP accounting memos where required.
• Ensure appropriate accounting procedures, controls and systems are implemented and followed.
• Participate in European finance projects, including system implementations, entity integrations, IFRS migrations and updates to policies and procedures.
• Contribute to process improvements and other ad-hoc finance projects.
• Support the Accounting Manager in guiding the Corporate Accounting team and provide advice on non-routine accounting matters.
• Help onboard and train new and existing team members.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent professional experience.
• At least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Solid experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within a services or retail environment.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with CRM/ERP migration or upgrade projects, particularly UAT, key-user or training responsibilities.
• SAP experience is required; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
• Experience in a multi-country or shared-services environment is a plus.
• Previous management experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English and French. German is considered a strong asset, while additional market languages are a plus.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft applications and advanced Excel skills.

Onze klant is een hoogtechnologisch bedrijf, een spin-off van de KUL dat fungeert als één van de grootste onderzoekscentra van Europa met verschillende uitdagingen. Onze klant is volop bezig met innovatie. Wil je mee aan de wieg staan qua ontwikkelingen naar artificiële intelligentie, nanotechnologie en ICT toe? Reageer dan snel. Wie weet krijg jij de kans om mee bij te dragen aan de technologie van morgen!

Jobomschrijving

Our customer, an innovative international organization in Leuven, is looking for an Administrative / Paralegal Officer to strengthen its team on a temporary basis. In this role, you will support business operations by managing contracts, quotations and purchase orders while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.

Expectied tasks: 

As an Administrative / Paralegal Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth administrative and contractual processes.

Your responsibilities include:

• Managing business contracts, including initiating approval workflows and coordinating electronic signatures.
• Drafting and processing business quotations while helping to standardize and optimize procedures.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency and accuracy before processing them.
• Communicating proactively with internal and external stakeholders regarding contract and order status.
• Building expertise in the business area you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks and quotation processes.
• Ensuring administrative accuracy and maintaining high-quality documentation.

Your profile

• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium to large-sized company, preferably within a complex business environment.
• You already gained initial experience in sales contract management, paralegal support, or a similar role.
• You are highly organized and able to manage priorities effectively.
• You work accurately and consistently deliver quality results.
• You thrive in a dynamic environment and adapt easily to changing processes.
• You can handle tight deadlines and a fast-paced workload.
• You are proficient with digital tools such as Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and document management platforms.
• You have excellent communication skills.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset.

Interested?

Would you like to join an international logistics team where your expertise can make a real impact? Send us your CV and we will be happy to discuss this opportunity with you.

Our customer is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. Diversity, inclusion, and respect are at the heart of their company culture

Jobomschrijving

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.
• Support the loading of pallets and cartons onto trucks when required.
• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.
• Continuously identify opportunities to optimize transport efficiency and reduce shipping costs.

Your Profile

• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.
• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability.

You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)

·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude

·        A professional and presentable appearance

·        Proficiency in Dutch or English

·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

Our client is a leader in the wind energy industry.

Jobomschrijving

The main responsibilities for this position are: providing maintenance, repair and support for wind turbines throughout Belgium to ensure the continuous operation of the machines.

The team leaves in the morning with a van from a service point. The service points are in: Jabbeke, Lokeren, Stabroek (Antwerp/Kapellen).

Profile:

- as wind turbine technician you have a bachelor's degree in a technical field or professional experience in a similar position

- knowledge of mechanics and/or electricity

- able to work at very high heights and in limited space

- you have a B driver's license

- you can speak English, French or Dutch

Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a complex retail and logistics environment. Technology plays a central role in supporting business operations, and the company is investing in delivering a high-quality IT support experience to its internal users.The position is based in the Dilbeek area.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Service Desk Support Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
• Logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and managing tickets through the ITSM platform.
• Performing first-line troubleshooting and resolving technical issues whenever possible.
• Supporting end-user devices, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and standard business applications.
• Assisting users with Microsoft 365 tools, Windows environments, user account administration, and connectivity issues.
• Managing and monitoring tickets through to resolution while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Escalating incidents to second-line support teams, external providers, or specialist teams when required.
• Following up on escalated incidents and ensuring timely resolution.
• Documenting solutions, workarounds, and recurring incidents to enrich the knowledge base.
• Collaborating with IT colleagues to improve processes, service quality, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will possess:

• Professional proficiency in French and Dutch, both written and spoken.
• A working knowledge of English for internal communication.
• Previous experience in IT support, service desk, helpdesk, or end-user support functions.
• Exposure to several of the following technologies:
• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
• Windows environments and first-level troubleshooting
• Active Directory and user administration
• Networking and connectivity fundamentals
• End-user hardware and peripherals
• Mobile device support
• Strong customer service and communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills with a structured approach to ticket management.
• Analytical problem-solving capabilities and the ability to prioritize effectively.
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine desire to develop technical skills further.

Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Jobomschrijving

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area? Accommodation is not provided

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.• VCA certificate is an advantage.• Category B driving licence.

Do you enjoy working accurately and prefer a hands-on job?
 

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.
 

What will you do?
 

- Check the quality and quantity of products before packing.
- Carefully pack parts according to the required specifications.
- Process orders based on instructions provided through a computer system or order form.
- Handle parts weighing up to 10 kg.

- You speak and understand Dutch or English.
- You are comfortable with standing work and handling parts up to 10 kg.
- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately.
- You are looking for a full-time position and work in a precise and structured way.

Our customer is an international organisation who specialises in the packaging of machine parts with a focus on efficiency and excellence. Their Core Values are flexibility, quality, speed and discretion.

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented, reliable, and looking for a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment? Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you!

 

We’re looking for enthusiastic employees to do the packaging of a wide variety of machine parts in Lokeren. As a Packaging Employee, you'll make sure our products are packed with care and precision, ready to be delivered to customers worldwide. For this job, you will use a scanning system and a computer to ensure everything is registered correctly.

Who are we looking for?

• Comfortable standing for long periods without discomfort.
• Available for long-term work, full-time from monday to friday.
• Lifting weights up to 10 kg is not a problem (no physical issues).
• Able to communicate in English and/or Dutch
• Experience as a packaging employee is a plus.

Our client specialises in the (re)packaging and distribution of different machine parts. You'll be working at a reliable employer, joining a team of motivated logistical experts.

Jobomschrijving

Deze international is gespecialiseerd in de productie en de toelevering van kunststofonderdelen voor de automobielindustrie; spuitgietonderdelen voor voertuigen.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment.

• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:

• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner
• Checking products for quality and quantity
• Preparing orders for shipment
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:

• Have experience as an Order Picker 
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully
• Speak English or Dutch
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:

• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile DescriptionWhat are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:

• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Flexibility, motivation, and a strong sense of responsibility

• Experience in pneumatics and hydraulics is a plus

• Problem-solving mindset

• Willingness to work shifts

As a freelance Head of Legal your responsibilities are:

• Lead the legal function and set clear priorities for legal work.
• Provide practical legal advice to support business decisions.
• Review legal matters and identify suitable actions for the organisation.
• Prepare and review legal documents to support business activities.
• Work with internal stakeholders to clarify legal needs and timelines.
• Manage external legal advisers where required for specific matters.
• Maintain clear records of legal matters and key decisions.
• Report on legal priorities and progress to relevant stakeholders.

• You have experience as head of legal;
• Experience from the industrial sector is a strong plus;
• You are fluent in English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business & Functional Analyst – Data Platform & Requirements Engineering
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Facilitate workshops with content managers, business experts, and key users to capture complex requirements.
• Map business processes including drafting, translation, validation, and publication workflows.
• Define user personas and journeys for internal employees, external professionals, and API partners.
• Manage and refine the product backlog using MoSCoW prioritization within an Agile framework.
• Specify document classification models and publication rules to ensure robust data governance.
• Validate functional increments and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in Business & Functional Analysis within complex IT and data environments.
• 8+ years of experience with Agile methodologies, including managing backlogs, epics, and user stories.
• 8+ years of experience in Requirements Engineering using frameworks such as Volère or Robertson.
• 8+ years of experience in process and information modeling using BPMN and UML.
• 3+ years of experience performing data analysis and hypothesis testing using SQL.
• You possess a proactive and result-oriented mindset with strong attention to both the big picture and data details.
• You are native in Dutch with good knowledge of French and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Data Governance and Data Modeling.
• Knowledge of API programs and integration patterns such as event-driven or pub/sub.
• Familiarity with architecture notations like Archimate or TOGAF.
• Experience with data visualization and analysis using Power BI or Python.
• Previous experience working within the public sector or large-scale organizations.
